`final class SdlKeys`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.lwjgl3.sdl.input` · **Module:** `base-lwjgl3-sdl` · **Source:** [SdlKeys.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/lwjgl3-sdl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/lwjgl3/sdl/input/SdlKeys.java)

Maps the scancodes of SDL 3 to the keys of JOID and back, by physical position or through the keyboard layout.

## Description

Its position table needs no SDL call, so a backend whose engine reports SDL scancodes reuses it; `getKey` reads the layout through SDL.

- [Keys](/build/base-modules/lwjgl3-sdl/#keys)

## Method details

<a id="SdlKeys-method-getCode"></a>

### getCode

`int getCode(Key key)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the SDL scancode at the physical position of the key, or `SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN` for a key that SDL does not name.

<a id="SdlKeys-method-getKey"></a>

### getKey

`Key getKey(int code)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the key that the scancode types on the current keyboard layout, read with `SDL_GetKeyFromScancode`: on an AZERTY keyboard, the scancode of `Q` gives `Key.A`.

<a id="SdlKeys-method-getPhysicalKey"></a>

### getPhysicalKey

`Key getPhysicalKey(int code)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the key at the physical position of the scancode, whatever the layout, or `Key.UNKNOWN`.

<a id="SdlKeys-method-isKeyDown"></a>

### isKeyDown

`boolean isKeyDown(Key key, IntPredicate down)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

If `true`, the key has an SDL scancode and the predicate reports that scancode as pressed.
